# Epaphras Prays for His Friends (Colossians 4:12)

## Emotional Focus
Being a quiet friend who prays for others.

## Key KJV
“Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers.” (Colossians 4:12)

## Gentle Retelling
Epaphras prayed hard for his friends even when he was far away. His prayers showed deep love and care.

## Coloring Prompt
Epaphras kneeling quietly with hands folded, thinking of his friends.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Praying for friends is one of the kindest things we can do.”
